name: Turmeric-Coconut Braised Chicken Thighs
recipeIngredient: 1 tbsp fresh ginger (peeled and finely grated)
1 can coconut milk (13.5 oz, full-fat, shaken)

recipeInstructions.text: Pat chicken thighs very dry. Season all over with salt and black pepper.
Heat neutral oil in a 3-quart dutch oven over medium-high. Sear the thighs skin-side down until deep golden, 4-5 minutes. Flip and brown 2 minutes more. Move to a plate; they won't be cooked through.
Lower the heat to medium and spoon off all but about 1 tbsp of fat. Add fresh ginger, ground turmeric, and garlic. Stir until fragrant, 30 seconds, without letting the turmeric burn.
Pour in coconut milk and water, scraping up the browned bits. Bring to a gentle simmer and season with salt and more pepper.
Return the thighs skin-side up, keeping the skin above the liquid. Cover with the lid ajar and simmer gently 25 minutes.
Squeeze in half of lime, then taste and add salt or more lime. Sprinkle with cilantro and a pinch of red pepper flakes.
Serve over jasmine rice with the rest of the lime in wedges.
If the sauce reduces too much, add a splash of water; if it's loose at the end, simmer uncovered 2 to 3 minutes. Keeps 3 days in the fridge, and the flavor deepens overnight.
